conf.comment: Tanium threat-response / syslog-leef: Connect emits a LEEF header followed by tab-delimited key=value attributes. Split the header with regex_extract, then serde-KVP the attribute body into tanium_fields per recommendations.direct.cribl. This work order's field table for this format is empty by design (attributes mirror the JSON format's columns, not enumerated here), so only columns named in the recommendation prose (Alert Id, Computer Name, Intel Name) are mapped; the nested Match Details/ATT&CK data this flat format cannot carry, plus host.ip/rule.id (need 'endpoint address'/'intel id' columns not attested here), are documented gaps. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: split the LEEF header (LEEF:ver|Tanium|product|ver|event id|) from the tab-delimited attribute body
extract the tab/space-delimited key=value attributes into a nested tanium_fields object
best-effort timestamp detection; no confidently-named timestamp column exists for this dataset in the work order
map Alert Id/Computer Name/Intel Name and tag event.dataset
